newsitem.title: USA: Flagstar says hires DLJ to aid structure.
newsitem.headline: Flagstar says hires DLJ to aid structure.

text.p: Flagstar Cos Inc said Tuesday it hired Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp to help it find options to improve its capital structure.

The company did not say what form a transaction -- if any -- would take. In a press statement, Flagstar characterized the hiring as a "positive first step toward reducing the debt the company incurred in a 1989 leveraged buyout by Coniston Partners."

The company said it has sufficient liquidity, although did not provide specific figures. It also said it is in compliance with the covenants of all of its outstanding debt obligations as of December 31.
Flagstar owns more than 3,200 restaurants, including the Coco's and Denny's chains.
